setting.reward: fixed GSM8K exact-answer verifier for replay accounting
setting.compute_definition: 2 * model parameter count * observed forward token slots; Qwen 1.5B and Qwen 0.5B are reported separately

summary.break_even_scope: arithmetic comparison against fresh continuous batching only; the default exact replay lifecycle consumes each evaluation record once, so repeated use of one frozen history library is not enabled by this result

decision.criterion: execution-only pairs must be token-exact; candidate reuse may add no main-model FLOPs and at most 5% wall time; continuous batching on cached replay must reduce mean online wall time by at least 5%; the full stack must reduce mean online wall time by at least 5% versus continuous-batched fresh-only execution and may add at most 5% total online FLOPs. The batching-only FLOP factor is reported as a trade-off (1.09385 in this summary) rather than hidden.
